quality.notes: Severe and systematic. The '(Primal Instinct)' suffix is attached to Tyler Barry, the external candidate, while Chris Klevan — the Primal Instinct person actually running the call — carries a bare label; the org tag is on the wrong party outright. Individual lines are also inverted: the 00:00:00 line under 'Chris Klevan' ('they actually accepted my 14% commission... because I'm number one') is plainly Tyler, and the 00:02:11 line under 'Tyler Barry (Primal Instinct)' ('I can't make you an offer consistent with that') is plainly Chris. Roles here were resolved entirely from content.
